applied_geometry_model.scope: Contiguous eager SGLang geometry, one indexer pass, before top-k, with the specified native score budget. Counts model logical work. Use the actual trace for how many passes took place, HBM traffic and device timing.

mask_formula: For the contiguous C2 path and absolute zero-based logical position p, floor((p+1)/2) compressed candidates are visible before top-k.
scope: Geometry of observed vLLM query/prefix schedules applied to the fixed SGLang dense score code and P score budget. Per-head cells use the confirmed 32 heads per rank. Current SGLang matched rank workload, actual number of scoring passes, physical traffic and timing remain unverified.
